request.subject: UNIT:CANDY:RAIDER

layers.text: Recolour only the frosting: the pink frosting dripping over the donut becomes dark chocolate glaze #4a2412, with a lighter #7a4526 shine and a few tiny cream and gold sprinkles. No pink is left on the donut. Keep the golden dough, the hole, the candy-corn rider, the small wheel, the speed lines, every shape, thick black outline and style the same, on a transparent background.
